scope: H2 application voice graph: feature producers, fixed background routes, owned startup/cache synthesis, closed admission, tracked cooperative cleanup and capture-callback barge-in. Partial-delivery timeout authority and per-stage budgets remain incomplete.
proven: The build_voice_services factory invoked by main injects one local output owner into timers, intercom, notification voice, high/critical alert broadcast and reminder delivery
Feature callbacks await actual response receipts; failed local intercom output is not marked delivered and does not fall through to HA TTS
Notification voice with no destination is not counted as delivered; background defaults are fixed configuration rather than mutable active-room state
Reminder without a presence detector delivers to an explicitly configured output zone; stopping owns its exact background task even before its first turn
Legacy routine speech uses one managed synthesis/output operation instead of treating the result of an independent speak call as PCM to play again
Warmup and response-cache TTS synthesis share the engine slot, run off-loop without playing, retain cancellation ownership until real worker exit, and cannot publish a late cancelled cache array
Close rejects new voice admission and waits active/pending controllers, actual audio/synthesis workers, async generation cleanup and quarantined legacy generation
Closing waits native client cleanup even when its output worker already exited; repeated caller cancellation cannot abandon the cooperative close
A native synthesis that outlives the deadline produces ResponseCloseTimeout with an occupied worker still reported, rejects new work and cannot start late audio; a later close can observe real exit
Partial feature startup failure stops attempted services, and the shared application lifecycle closes producers before voice output and stores

The real MultiRoomAudioLoop callback accepts synthetic frames during network thinking, detects barge-in while actual owned PCM is consumed, cancels the HTTP/SSE and device, opens listening and accepts the next capture
A following response contains only its own PCM; the cancelled device does not receive a late tail
The compiled runtime outside the source checkout builds/starts/stops the feature factory and confirms closed voice status and terminated producer tasks without hardware
